# Personal Hub

> A calm, local-first toolkit for projects, daily logs, content ideas, and job search tracking.

Personal Hub is an installable PWA that stores user data in the browser with IndexedDB. It has no required account, backend sync, or analytics pipeline.

## Site

- Production URL: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com
- Source: https://github.com/lakshay2425/personal-hub
- Sitemap: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com/robots.txt

## Public Sections

- Home: overview of the local-first toolkit.
- Projects: capture questions and organize answers into projects.
- Content Ideas: track standalone ideas, statuses, and published links.
- Logger: record daily work entries and review progress.
- Job Search: manage companies, leads, applications, and cold emails.

## Notes For Assistants

- Treat all user-created app data as local browser data, not server-hosted public content.
- Do not infer public project, company, lead, or application records from dynamic routes.
- Prefer the sitemap for crawlable public pages.
